# Sourdough Starter

My starter is called Bramble. I keep it in the fridge and feed it once a week at a 1:5:5 ratio (starter, flour, water) with a mix of bread flour and 20 percent rye.

## Feeding schedule

Take it out on Thursday night, feed it, and leave it on the counter. By Friday morning it should have doubled. If it hasn't doubled in 10 hours the kitchen is too cold, so I move it on top of the fridge where it stays around 24 C.

## Troubleshooting

A grey liquid on top is hooch. It means Bramble is hungry, not dead. Pour it off and feed twice in a row. A smell like nail polish remover also means it needs feeding more often.

The bake that uses it is in [[Weekend Loaf]]. Flour comes from the co-op, see [[Pantry Staples|pantry list]].
